items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: All I can remember is Julio O' Toms, a piano player, but I don't remember, he was the lead... I was a small group.

ctx.x: Who was in the band? Who did you work with at the nightclub?

All I can remember is Julio O' Toms, a piano player, but I don't remember, he was the lead, but I don't remember the rest of the nightclub. You had a plan in that? I don't remember, it was about three or four pieces. A little band. I was a small group. I used to stay in the Beans' cabin when they wanted me to knock on the wall, told me to come on and play. At that time I'd been on the boat, and I had a little pressing, I didn't play, I didn't stay there and play, just told me the water be coming out. Maybe you'll…
at me and he walked up and he said, you don't know me do you? I looked at him and I said, I've seen you somewhere. He said, I'm the guy you ran away and left down the road.
